remarks: Welcome to this stunning five-bedroom colonial, nestled on a highly sought-after cul-de-sac on Bennington Place. This charming residence is set on 3.66 acres of private, tranquil land, providing the perfect backdrop for serene living. As you approach the home, you're greeted by a picturesque covered wraparound porch, ideal for enjoying your morning coffee or relaxing in the evening. Step inside to find a beautifully appointed formal living room, dining room, and library each exuding elegance and style. The heart of this home is its renovated kitchen, featuring a spacious island and a cozy dining area with a vaulted ceiling and French doors that open onto a deck. The adjacent great room boasts a cathedral ceiling, window seat, fireplace, built-ins and French doors that also lead to the deck-making it perfect for both entertaining and everyday living. Retreat to the primary suite, which offers a private balcony, walk-in closet and luxurious en-suite bath. Additionally, the finished third-floor suite provides a versatile space with a bedroom, sitting area and full bath, ideal for guests or as a serene hideaway. The walkout lower level is equally impressive, complete with built-ins and a wine cellar, offering an exceptional space for leisure and gatherings. This exceptional home combines classic charm with modern amenities. Don't miss your chance to make this dream home your own.
